title: Point of Sale: Sell at the Counter with the Same Store | CrestApps for Orchard Core
description:
A store that sells online and at a counter often keeps two systems, and its products, prices and stock drift apart. The CrestApps Point of Sale module lets your staff sell at the counter of each store from a phone, a tablet or a till computer, using the same products, prices, coupons, gift cards and stock as your online store, and keeps every cash drawer honest.

In this video:
• Why a point of sale, and how registers, shifts and sales fit together
• What to have ready: stores, roles and sign-in
• Setting up registers
• A day at the till: opening a shift, ringing up and paying for a sale, receipts, cash in and out, returns and closing
• Reading shifts: sales, cash kept, card, the cash drawer and its difference
• Register sales as orders
• Use cases
